entries.meaningZh: 抓住你了！（口语，got you 的发音写法）
entries.en: 'Gotcha!' she cried, tagging her younger brother just before he reached the garden gate.
entries.zh: “抓住你了！”她喊道，在弟弟快到花园门口时伸手碰到了他。

entries.en: Her mother's sister in Haifa sent a photograph of the view from her balcony.
entries.zh: 她住在海法的姨妈寄来了一张从自家阳台拍摄的照片。
